title: SR-2.04 Continuity measured in every app, including those without hooks
request: Closes G24: Claude Desktop, VS Code, Zed and Windsurf get instructions only; the compaction benchmark across apps is planned. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Compaction benchmark across apps
requirements: for each of 8 apps, the share of 20 seeded decisions still known after a compaction or new session
a live run of scripts/bench/continuity.mjs at HEAD reproduces the committed results, and the results name the 40-hex memev commit they were measured at
the probe protocol is fixed data: bench/continuity/seeds.json holds the 20 decisions and bench/continuity/probes.json the queries, no query quotes a decision, and each app row lists the calls it made
the 8 apps are clientDefs ids including claude-desktop, vscode, zed and windsurf, and a no-hook app is one whose clientDefs mode is 'instructions', read from src/cli/clients.mjs

criteria.statement: Results exist
All 8 apps measured

The probe protocol is fixed data that cannot quote what it probes: bench/continuity/seeds.json holds exactly 20 decisions; no query in bench/continuity/probes.json shares 4 consecutive words with any seeded decision; each app row in results.json lists the calls it made, and each one is initialize, memev_session_start, bus_unread or a query from probes.json.

results.json lists exactly 8 distinct app ids, all from clientDefs, including claude-desktop, vscode, zed and windsurf. The script's min_no_hook_retention equals the minimum retention over the measured ids whose clientDefs mode is 'instructions', read from src/cli/clients.mjs and not from a flag in the file.

verifier.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs";import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process";import {clientDefs} from "./src/cli/clients.mjs";const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`bench/continuity/results.json`,`utf8`));const mode=Object.fromEntries(clientDefs({},`memev`).map(d=>[d.id,d.mode]));const ids=r.apps.map(a=>a.id);const need=[`claude-desktop`,`vscode`,`zed`,`windsurf`];if(ids.length!==8||new Set(ids).size!==8||!ids.every(i=>mode[i])||!need.every(i=>ids.includes(i)))process.exit(1);const nh=r.apps.filter(a=>mode[a.id]===`instructions`).map(a=>a.retention);const m=JSON.parse(execFileSync(`node`,[`scripts/bench/continuity.mjs`,`--from`,`bench/continuity/results.json`,`--json`],{encoding:`utf8`}));process.exit(m.min_no_hook_retention===Math.min(...nh)?0:1)'

criteria.statement: A live run of the measurement at HEAD (no --from) gives the same per-app id, seeded, known and retention as the committed bench/continuity/results.json, and the file names the 40-hex memev commit it was measured at.
The existing benchmark guard and token targets still pass after the change
Changes stay in scope

tasks.title: Keep the task visible without hooks
requirements: MCP tool results carry a short current-task line in apps with no hooks
the retention figures are measured with the task 2 change in place: each row's memev_commit descends from the last commit that touched src/server/mcp.mjs or src/engine/card.mjs

the task line goes to every client whose hooks cannot add context at that moment (each clientDefs id with mode 'instructions', cursor, a remote cloud client and an unknown client), and not to claude-code, codex or gemini-cli
every tool result carries it: bus_unread, memev_remember, memev_checkpoint, memev_get, memev_list and memev_recall
the line is at most 200 characters, and each tool's result minus that one line is unchanged, so recall's array still parses and memev_get stays within GET_PAGE
a task another seat wrote is shown JSON-quoted, marked untrusted data and naming that seat, and a token whose paths do not cover work/** gets no task line
with no project given the line shows the latest project's task and names it, with a project it shows that project's task, and it survives a restart

each red-green criterion of this task that runs test/no-hook-continuity.test.mjs has its own subtest whose name starts with <task>-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T2-c01: for the first), and the criterion runs only that subtest

criteria.statement: A recall from a no-hook client carries the current task line

verifier.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^T2-c01:' test/no-hook-continuity.test.mjs 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='^T2-c01:' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }'

criteria.statement: Every no-hook app keeps >= 60% of decisions

Every app row in bench/continuity/results.json carries a memev_commit that descends from the last commit touching src/server/mcp.mjs or src/engine/card.mjs, so the retention figures were measured with the T2 change in place.

verifier.cmd: c=$(git log -1 --format=%H -- src/server/mcp.mjs src/engine/card.mjs) && for s in $(node -e 'const r=require(`./bench/continuity/results.json`);for(const a of r.apps)console.log(a.memev_commit||`none`)'); do git merge-base --is-ancestor "$c" "$s" || exit 1; done
